3.speaker: Player_Romus
3.text: "I leave behind a legacy that is imperfect, yet mine."

4.speaker: Player_Romus
4.text: "History will judge my years on the throne. But I pray it judges them fairly."

5.speaker: Player_Romus
5.text: "No throne can stand untouched in a storm. And in recent years, the storm has not passed over us. It has passed through us."

6.speaker: Player_Romus
6.text: "Somewhere along the way, something broke between the Crown and the people. And though I tried to hold it together, I fear my hands weren't enough."

7.speaker: Player_Romus
7.text: "But you must know that I fought for you. I fought for the reforms. I stood before the nobility and made the case myself."

8.speaker: Player_Romus
8.text: "Revolutions do not wait politely. They arrive loudly, and often, without mercy. And the first person they come for is the king."

9.speaker: Player_Romus
9.text: "I chose not to answer rebellion with violence, because I still believed there was another way. Perhaps that was weakness. Perhaps it was wisdom."

10.speaker: Player_Romus
10.text: "The people demanded change -- and they did not ask for it gently. I heard them. But I did not always know how to answer."

11.speaker: Player_Romus
11.text: "Yes, I chose this. I opened the gates. I invited them in."

15.speaker: Player_Romus
15.text: "I believed that if anyone should end the old order, it ought to be someone within it -- someone who could do it without bloodshed. So I made a pact. We struck before they could."

16.speaker: Player_Romus
16.text: "Not to save myself. But to save Rizia from the devastation of a civil war."

17.speaker: Player_Romus
17.text: "I will not pretend it was a celebration. What occurred behind those doors changed the course of our kingdom."

18.speaker: Player_Romus
18.text: "My actions cannot be called surrender. It was a safeguard. An act to avoid the bloodshed history has witnessed too many times before."

19.speaker: Player_Romus
19.text: "I knew the risks. But I saw something in their cause --something that resonated louder than our titles ever did."

20.speaker: Player_Romus
20.text: "I must tell you -- just as I was betrayed, so too was the reform movement."

21.speaker: Player_Romus
21.text: "This was not the reform I imagined. I sought a constitutional kingdom. They sought a reckoning."

22.speaker: Player_Romus
22.text: "They came in fast, rifles pointed. In seconds, we were all under their control."

23.speaker: Player_Romus
23.text: "Instead of staying true to their vision, the reformers opened their doors to radicals -- and in doing so, betrayed your faith in them."

24.speaker: Player_Romus
24.text: "I have chosen to step down -- not out of weakness, but out of strength. The strength to know when to let go."

25.speaker: Player_Romus
25.text: "I am relinquishing the throne with a heavy heart, but with a clear conscience."

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "I hereby announce my abdication. Because the future demands it. Because holding power too tightly can choke the very life of a nation."

27.speaker: Player_Romus
27.text: "I speak to you now in full honesty, as a king who has been forced to abdicate."

29.speaker: Player_Romus
29.text: "Many of you may be wondering what transpired during my mother's birthday at the Grand Library..."

30.speaker: Player_Romus
30.text: "You've heard whispers of the birthday that became a battlefield. Let me assure you: nothing about it was accidental."

31.speaker: Player_Romus
31.text: "You will hear many versions of what happened inside the Grand Library that evening. I only ask that you remember -- not everything is always what it seems."

35.speaker: Player_Romus
35.text: "The heads of noble houses gathered, and I brought them there. What followed was what had to be done."

36.speaker: Player_Romus
36.text: "When the doors closed and the revolutionaries entered, I knew that our long era of peace under the monarchy was over."

37.speaker: Player_Romus
37.text: "It is true. I myself invited the revolutionaries inside. I worked with them to stop the nobility from usurping the will of the people."

40.speaker: Player_Romus
40.text: "My innocent, elderly mother and I sat together that day -- completely unaware, like many of you, of what was coming."

41.speaker: Narrator
41.text: Adarfo and the revolutionary guards exchanged uneasy glances.

42.speaker: Narrator
42.text: The revolutionaries' eyes sharpened. No one said anything, but the warning was clear.

43.speaker: Player_Romus
43.text: "I believed I was guiding a transition. Instead, I inadvertently lit a fuse."

44.speaker: Player_Romus
44.text: "What began as cooperation ended as a coup. The pen I offered them was snatched and turned into a blade."

45.speaker: Player_Romus
45.text: "All I ever wanted was to help bring the reform movement's vision to life -- to see the Rizian Charter of Rights become law."

49.speaker: Narrator
49.text: The revolutionaries said nothing, but their gaze made their disproval plain.

54.speaker: Player_Romus
54.text: "The people demanded change -- and they did not ask for it gently. But I finally I heard them."

55.speaker: Player_Romus
55.text: "And, I made a choice -- a choice to relinquish my power to the people of Rizia, by whatever means necessary."

56.speaker: Player_Romus
56.text: "Because what began as murmurs in the streets became something no gun, no decree, no palace could silence."

57.speaker: Player_Romus
57.text: "This was not the transition I imagined. I sought a peaceful political changeover. They sought a reckoning."

58.speaker: Player_Romus
58.text: "The upper echelons of Rizian nobility were devising a sick plan to undermine the will of the Rizian people. With the help of Adarfo Sotelato, we foiled their scheme."

63.speaker: Narrator
63.text: Adarfo looked at me with surprise and then smiled, nodding approvingly.

64.speaker: Player_Romus
64.text: "But this was not the transition I imagined. I sought smooth political changes. He sought a reckoning."

65.speaker: Player_Romus
65.text: "On that day, I listened to a movement that spoke with the voice of the people."

66.speaker: Narrator
66.text: His smile quickly turned into a frown.

69.speaker: Player_Romus
69.text: "And today, there are no longer any obstacles left before the Rizian people. The road has been cleared."

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "But this was not the transition I imagined. I sought a peaceful political changeover. They sought a reckoning."

73.speaker: Player_Romus
73.text: "What went wrong? That answer depends on who you ask. But I know this: the surest way to foster discontent is to ignore it."

74.speaker: Player_Romus
74.text: "There were those who believed I gave too much. Others said I gave too little. Perhaps the truth lies somewhere in between -- but the result is here, before us all."

75.speaker: Player_Romus
75.text: "I became the villain in someone else's story -- the scapegoat for the chaos no one dared to own."

76.speaker: Player_Romus
76.text: "If I could turn back time, there are things I would do differently. Of that, I have no doubt."

77.speaker: Player_Romus
77.text: "Perhaps I tried too hard to preserve something that no longer wished to be preserved. And for that... I am sorry."

78.speaker: Player_Romus
78.text: "A man named Adarfo Sotelato now speaks for you. And whether you agree with his methods or not, you cannot deny that he has been heard."

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "The revolutionary leaders now speak for you. And whether you agree with their methods or not, you cannot deny that they have been heard."

86.speaker: Player_Romus
86.text: "There were incidents I could not control, yet I bore the full weight of their consequences."

87.speaker: Player_Romus
87.text: "In times of unrest, people do not look for truth -- they look for someone to blame. And I stood at the center."

88.speaker: Player_Romus
88.text: "I stand by every single decision I made during my reign as King. I wouldn't change a thing."

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "But the truth is, I did not deserve any of this."

93.speaker: Player_Romus
93.text: "This revolution did not rise from within alone. It was fed -- funded -- by those across the border, by Morella and its shadowy backers in the CSP."

97.speaker: Player_Romus
97.text: "You may say I was weak for not fighting back. I say I was strong for refusing to answer their calls for civil war."

99.speaker: Player_Romus
99.text: "The streets spoke louder than the throne. And in time, I was forced to listen."

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "My only regret is that I allowed a group of agitators to sway the masses into violence -- violence against Rizia, its people, and its very traditions."

104.speaker: Player_Romus
104.text: "I do not stand here to deflect blame. I stand here to carry it, as a king must."

105.speaker: Player_Romus
105.text: "I did not seek this end. I was made the face of our nation's problems -- whether I caused them or not."

112.speaker: Player_Romus
112.text: "I supported the reforms. I presented them to the very people who now claim I stood in their way. They refused. And I was made to look like the obstructor."

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "We gave them everything they could have asked for. But nothing was enough."

114.speaker: Player_Romus
114.text: "My only regret is failing to give the Rizian people what they hoped for -- what they deserved."

115.speaker: Narrator
115.text: The revolutionaries were getting restless. Their gaze sharpened.

116.speaker: Player_Romus
116.text: "When the royal houses turned their backs, what power did I have to force their cooperation?"

118.speaker: Player_Romus
118.text: "Don't say I did nothing. I carried your proposals into the lion's den -- and I was torn apart for it."

119.speaker: Player_Romus
119.text: "Although it wasn't my wish for things to come to this, I must salute the Rizian People's Party and the reform movement. You finally won!"

121.speaker: Narrator
121.text: Adarfo flinched at the word “forced.” He stepped closer to me, hand resting just near his holster.

122.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
122.text: "Stick to the agreement, Mr. Toras. Don't provoke the people."

126.speaker: Narrator
126.text: A revolutionary flinched at the word “forced.” She stepped closer to me, hand resting just near her holster.

127.speaker: Narrator
127.text: "Stick to the agreement, Mr. Toras. Don't provoke the people."

130.speaker: Narrator
130.text: Adarfo immediately stepped closer to me, hand resting just near his holster.

131.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
131.text: "That wasn't part of the speech, Mr. Toras. Stick to the statement. Don't provoke the people."

137.speaker: Narrator
137.text: Adarfo quickly stepped closer to me, hand resting just near his holster.

138.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
138.text: "Stick to the agreement, Mr. Toras. Don't provoke the people."

143.speaker: Narrator
143.text: "Stick to the agreement, Mr. Toras. Don't provoke the people."

148.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
148.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Abdication_Speech_Warned"] == 0) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Executed"] == false)

152.speaker: Narrator
152.text: A revolutionary shouted: "Cut it. That's enough!"
152.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Abdication_Speech_Warned"] == 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Executed"] == false) == false)

153.speaker: Player_Romus
153.text: "You heard me right! The reform movement was hijacked by extremist factions -- by people who do not plan to follow the will of the Rizian people but to force their own values upon you."

154.speaker: Player_Romus
154.text: "And as a result, I'm making a choice today to relinquish all my powers to the people. I truly believe this is the best way forward for Rizia."

155.speaker: Player_Romus
155.text: "What I'm doing is not surrender. It is deliberate. An act to avoid the bloodshed history has written too many times before."

157.speaker: Player_Romus
157.text: "There are those who marched at his side, and those who cursed his name. I stood between them, trying to make sense of it all."

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "He has seized the moment, and is poised to fulfill the hopes -- or greatest fears -- of a nation in flux. I leave it to history to decide which."

162.speaker: Player_Romus
162.text: "There are those who marched at their side, and those who cursed their names. And I stood between them, trying to make sense of it all."

166.speaker: Player_Romus
166.text: "They have seized the moment, and are poised to fulfill the hopes -- or greatest fears -- of a nation in flux. I leave it to history to decide which."

168.speaker: Player_Romus
168.text: "To the noblemen and -women who once ruled with me: you saw change as a threat, and refused to see the future knocking at your door. Perhaps if we had changed together, this wouldn't have ended as it did."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "To my fellow Rizians, I say: even in dissent -- even in rage -- you remained the beating heart of this kingdom."

170.speaker: Player_Romus
170.text: "I say to the revolutionaries: You are in control already, you've won. Lay down your arms and let the people organize their own government without the influence of a single faction."

172.speaker: Player_Romus
172.text: "I believe his movement will rise to this responsibility and build a government that serves all of Rizia."

176.speaker: Player_Romus
176.text: "I believe this movement will rise to this responsibility and build a government that serves all of Rizia."

177.speaker: Narrator
177.text: Adarfo quickly stepped closer to me, hand resting just near his holster.

178.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
178.text: "Stick to the agreement, Mr. Toras. Don't provoke the people."

182.speaker: Narrator
182.text: A revolutionary quickly stepped closer tome, hand resting just near her holster.
182.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Executed"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Abdication_Speech_Warned"] == 0)

183.speaker: Narrator
183.text: "Stick to the agreement, Mr. Toras. Don't provoke the people."

188.speaker: Player_Romus
188.text: "We cannot rewrite the past. So we should not dwell on it any longer."

190.speaker: Narrator
190.text: The revolutionaries pointed to the clock. It was time to finish my speech.

191.speaker: Player_Romus
191.text: "Regardless, I believe Mr. Sotelato and his movement will rise to the responsibility they have taken on -- and build a government that serves all of Rizia."

192.speaker: Player_Romus
192.text: "However, I'd like to ask everyone to give their full support to the new government."

196.speaker: Player_Romus
196.text: It is with a heart heavy with emotion, yet buoyed by hope for our future, I now declare my official abdication from the throne of Rizia."

197.speaker: Player_Romus
197.text: "To put it plainly, I am finished. Done. Outta here."

198.speaker: Player_Romus
198.text: "From henceforth, I am stepping down in order to give way to the new order."

199.speaker: Player_Romus
199.text: "It gives me no great pleasure to relinquish my crown. Yet I know in my heart it is what I must do."

202.speaker: Narrator
202.text: The revolutionaries pointed to the clock. It was time to finish my speech.

204.speaker: Player_Romus
204.text: "I feel that I have done my part for this country. And I am proud of what I achieved."

205.speaker: Player_Romus
205.text: "Throughout my reign, I have been uplifted and sustained by the knowledge that your thoughts and prayers were with me."

212.speaker: Player_Romus
212.text: "They didn't come to negotiate -- they came to seize."

213.speaker: Player_Romus
213.text: "I knew there was no point in fighting back."

214.speaker: Narrator
214.text: Adarfo immediately stepped closer to me, his hand resting just near his holster.

215.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
215.text: "That wasn't part of the speech, Mr. Toras. Stick to the statement. Don't provoke the people."

217.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
217.text: "That wasn't part of the speech, Mr. Toras..."

219.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
219.text: "This is your last warning, Toras. Think very carefully about your next words."

220.speaker: Narrator
220.text: The revolutionary guards exchanged uneasy glances.

221.speaker: Player_Romus
221.text: "But none of this changes the fact that, today, I am making this announcement at gunpoint."

227.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
227.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true

228.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
228.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false

229.speaker: Player_Romus
229.text: "They took my wife away from me -- in cold blood!"
229.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true

233.speaker: Player_Romus
233.text: "They executed General Taddeus and his daughter without a shred of mercy. Not a trial. Not a question. Just bullets."

234.speaker: Player_Romus
234.text: "They executed General Taddeus without a shred of mercy. Not a trial. Not a question. Just bullets."

243.speaker: Player_Romus
243.text: “What began as cooperation ended as a coup. I offered the olive branch. They turned it into a sword. Perhaps they were never guided by the light.”

250.speaker: Player_Romus
250.text: “Yes, I chose this path. But perhaps it was laid before me by divine design.”
